Detect co-expression modules

Source: R/analysis_wgcna.R
run_wgcna.Rd

Detect co-expression modules

Usage

run_wgcna(
  datExpr,
  power,
  network_type = "signed",
  min_module_size = 30,
  merge_cut_height = 0.25,
  deep_split = 2
)

Arguments

datExpr

samples x genes matrix

power

soft-thresholding power

network_type

"signed" (default), "unsigned", "signed hybrid"

min_module_size

minimum module size

merge_cut_height

dendrogram cut for merging close modules

deep_split

sensitivity of the tree cut (0-4)

Value

a list: modules (named vector gene -> color), MEs (module eigengenes, samples x modules), power, n_samples, datExpr, dendro (the blockwise dendrogram)
